top_story: As Israeli officials moved from siege to openly stated plans for large-scale Palestinian expulsion from Gaza on 28 May, the enclave’s humanitarian collapse deepened, with protests over World Central Kitchen cutbacks underscoring how blockade, hunger, and displacement pressure now reinforce each other. The regional picture is one of simultaneous radicalization and transactional diplomacy, with civilians bearing the immediate burden while states narrow room for accountability and de-escalation.
